title: Pick specimens
purpose: Record the retrieval of a request's allocated specimens from storage, or that one was not found.
summary: Record retrieving a request's allocated specimens from storage, or that one was not found.

tasks.title: Record the pick
steps: Set each row's [[Outcome]]: Picked, Not found or Not now.
Choose [[Picked by (custodian)]], enter [[Picked at]] and the [[Reason]], then select [[Record pick]].

tasks.title: Print the list first
steps: Open the pick list from the request and select Download PDF.

good_to_know: Picked checks the specimen out of storage. Its position is freed and time out of storage starts.
Not found records only that it was not at its location.

sections.title: Who can use it
paragraphs: Technicians, managers and administrators, while the request is approved and has specimens allocated and not yet picked. It opens in a wide dialog that can be maximized.

sections.title: The grid
paragraphs: One row per allocated specimen in walking order (site, room, unit, rack slots, box, position; specimens not in storage last), as on the pick list, with its location, amount, consent restrictions and anything that would refuse picking it now.

items.label: Outcome
items.description: Picked checks the specimen out of storage; Not found records only that it was not at its location; Not now leaves it allocated. Rows that would be refused start on Not now.

items.label: Note
items.description: Optional, up to 500 characters, for example where a missing specimen was looked for. Do not enter names, signatures, record numbers, birth dates or contact details of a participant.

items.label: Picked by (custodian)
items.description: Required: the operating staff member who holds the specimens once checked out; you by default.

items.label: Picked at
items.description: Required; repository local time, not in the future and not before the specimens were allocated.

items.label: Reason
items.description: Required, kept with each check-out and allocation event. Do not enter names, signatures, record numbers, birth dates or contact details of a participant.

sections.title: What happens
paragraphs: Record pick needs at least one row marked Picked or Not found. Each picked specimen is checked out to the custodian with the destination Request RQ-…: its position becomes free, the time-out-of-storage clock starts, and the allocation becomes Picked. Every specimen is checked again first; if any is refused or changed since the page was opened (its record or storage position), nothing is saved and the reasons are shown. Not found changes nothing else; the specimen stays allocated.
